claims.text: Sol Foundation Briefing No. 3 (April 2026) presents peer-reviewed atomic and isotopic analysis of possible UAP materials from a multi-witness event, conducted by Nolan.

Sol Foundation Science and Policy Briefing No. 3 (April 2026), by Marik von Rennenkampff, presents peer-reviewed atomic and isotopic analysis of possible UAP materials from a multi-witness event, associated with Garry Nolan.

b.label: AARO / Oak Ridge National Laboratory materials analyses

edges.label: competing materials programme
edges.note: The Sol Foundation's April 2026 peer-reviewed atomic and isotopic analysis of possible UAP material is the private-sector counterpart to AARO's two ORNL specimen studies, both of which resolved to terrestrial manufacture.

edges.note: Von Rennenkampff is the named author of 'First Peer-Reviewed Scientific Analysis of Possible UAP Materials Employs State-of-the-Art Technologies,' The Sol Foundation Science and Policy Briefings No. 3, April 2026.
